curatorNote: Coverage uses the current first-party SONIC August 2026 National Nutritional Brochure and includes 120 verified food products and size variants across burgers, kids-meal foods, sandwiches, chicken, hot dogs, breakfast, snacks and sides, frozen desserts, and sundaes. Beverages were excluded. SONIC notes that availability and nutrition can vary by location, serving variation, special ordering, suppliers, and product changes.

qualityReview.note: Verified retained items’ calories, carbohydrates, protein, fat, fiber, and sodium against SONIC’s first-party Summer 2026 nutritional PDF on August 21, 2026. Wacky Pack® components were removed because they are not full food-only purchases. SONIC Blasts were retained because SONIC categorizes them under Sweets/frozen desserts, not Drinks. Calcium, iron, magnesium, potassium, vitamin D, and serving weights were not supplied by the verified source and remain null; location, availability, and custom-order variation may apply.
